Bed Bug Eddie's clams oreganata.d: On the half shell under garlic, oregano and parmesan crumbs.
Bed Bug Eddie's clams oreganata.note: Mr. Grant's table gets the first plate.

Waiter's antipasto.d: Ripe cantaloupe, sliced ham, bocconcini in basil oil.
Waiter's antipasto.note: What the captain plates every night.

Veal marsala.d: Escalopes seared in butter, button mushrooms, glossy wine sauce.
Veal marsala.note: Order the veal. The captain says so.

Zabaglione.d: Marsala custard whisked warm at your table, over strawberries.

Charlie's Americano on Paulie's tab.d: Red aperitivo, sweet vermouth, soda and orange. Paulie's tab.
Charlie's Americano on Paulie's tab.note: Paulie always has a plan, never the money.
